title: APK: fix install on Android 16 + add real launcher icon
body: ## Summary User reported the v1.0.0 APK won't install on Android 16 and shows no launcher icon. Two root causes: 1. **Adaptive icon was using `@android:color/...` as drawable refs**, which newer Android resource parsers reject when validating the manifest. This is the most likely cause of the install failure on A16 (and the missing icon, since the parser bails out before assigning one). 2. **`compileSdk` / `targetSdk` was 34** (Android 14). Bumped to 35 (Android 15) for A16 forward-compat. Fixes in this PR (vs the old `experiment` head `cd60ccc`): - Add proper vector drawables: `ic_launcher_background.xml` (solid `#0E0E10`), `ic_launcher_foreground.xml` (white "V" mark in safe zone), `ic_launcher_monochrome.xml` (themed-icon layer for Android 13+). - Update both `mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml` and `ic_launcher_round.xml` to reference the real drawables (and add a `` line for themed icons). - Bump `compileSdk` 34 → 35, `targetSdk` 34 → 35. - Bump `versionCode` 1 → 2, `versionName` `0.1.0` → `1.0.1`. - Explicitly enable v1+v2+v3 signing schemes on the debug keystore so the produced APK installs cleanly on Android 14/15/16. This supersedes PR #1, which targets a renamed branch (`devin/1777553164-malivk13-initial` → `experiment`) that GitHub no longer accepts pushes to. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] CI green on this PR (`build-apk` is the one that matters; the other 5 should be unaffected). - [ ] Install the resulting APK on an Android 16 device. Should install without "App not installed" / parser errors. - [ ] Confirm the launcher icon shows up (dark square + white "V"). - [ ] Confirm themed-icon support (Pixel: Settings → Wallpaper & style → Themed icons → toggle on). - [ ] Run the patcher end-to-end on a real `vendor.img` and verify the output passes the Mali-file-size + build.prop checker we ran earlier. ### Notes The previous `v1.0.0` release will be replaced (or augmented) with `v1.0.1` once this lands and the CI artifact is downloaded. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/905561e571974c86a4909b89e75ea6e4 Requested by: @Swaggyxren ---
